figures.caption: Fig. 2: Overview of our semantics-guided multimodal masked autoencoder pretraining framework for downstream 3D BEV object detection. The purple blocks denote the components newly introduced in our method: semantics-guided LiDAR voxel masking and decoder-side point semantic supervision. The dotted blue boundary marks the pretraining-only part of the framework, indicating that all components inside it are used only during pretraining.
